name: aurora-context
description: MCP server that helps developers find and consume Aurora Cloud microservice endpoints: semantic search over OpenAPI specs, generated service docs, symbol lookup, callers/callees and impact analysis across services.

name: azure-devops
description: MCP server for Azure DevOps: query and update work items with WIQL, read sprint iterations and team capacity, backlog, comments, repositories, pull requests, pipelines and wiki search.

name: microsoft-365
install: Conector gerenciado pelo time de Plataforma
description: MCP connector for Microsoft 365: search Outlook email and calendar, Teams chats and channels, SharePoint documents, people lookup and meeting availability.

name: n8n-skills
description: Claude Code plugin with skills and hooks for building n8n workflows: node configuration, expressions, code nodes, AI agents, credentials, error handling, loops, sub-workflows and debugging of executions.

name: excalidraw
description: Plugin that generates Excalidraw architecture diagrams from natural language or directly from a codebase: component diagrams, service maps and box-and-arrow system views.

name: engram
description: Plugin that operates a team knowledge base in Obsidian: discovers the vault ontology, ingests documents and PDFs, captures notes, links them in a graph, audits broken links and answers questions citing source notes.

name: skill-validator
description: CLI that validates Agent Skill folders before publishing to the catalog: frontmatter, structure, broken references and leaked secrets, plus semantic quality and risk scoring with the Jev decision model.

name: aurora-bff-scaffold
description: Scaffolds a new Aurora Cloud backend service in C#/.NET following the platform conventions: domain, primitives, events, security resources and the generated REST endpoints. Use when creating a new microservice or BFF.

name: aurora-code-review
description: Reviews pull requests of Aurora Cloud services against the platform checklist: tenant isolation, permission resources, event contracts, breaking API changes, logging of personal data (LGPD) and .NET conventions.

name: aurora-design-system
description: Builds Aurora Cloud screens in React with the corporate design system: component catalog, tokens, forms, data grids, accessibility rules and i18n in pt-BR, en-US and es-ES.

name: aurora-api-docs
description: Writes and updates public API documentation for Aurora Cloud services from the OpenAPI spec: endpoint guides, authentication, examples in cURL and C#, and changelog of breaking changes.

name: aurora-integration-tests
description: Creates integration and contract tests for Aurora Cloud services in .NET: tenant fixtures, authenticated clients, event publishing assertions and test data cleanup in CI.

name: sprint-report
description: Generates the weekly sprint status report from Azure DevOps: scope, burndown, capacity vs remaining work per person and per stream, estimate factor, blockers found in comments and backlog hygiene issues, delivered as an HTML page.
